response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with a strong background in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and relational databases, which aligns well with the role's requirements. However, his recent focus on AI-agent infrastructure and non-traditional stacks (e.g., Dlang) may require adaptation to the renewable energy/construction tech domain. His pragmatic problem-solving and collaboration skills are evident, making him a strong candidate despite some domain mismatch.
strengths: Deep fullstack expertise with TypeScript, React, and Node.js across multiple roles
Proven ability to integrate complex systems and optimize performance (e.g., pricing optimization at Optilyz)
Strong collaboration and mentorship skills demonstrated through workshops and open-source contributions
concerns: Limited recent experience with PostgreSQL (primary required DB) and clean software architecture in the listed roles
Overqualified for entry-level role; may seek higher compensation or challenge within 6-12 months
Recent focus on AI/ML and non-traditional stacks (Dlang) may require ramp-up time for core responsibilities

key_factors.factor: Domain experience in renewable energy/construction tech
